an10.215:1.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing ten qualities, a female lay follower dwells without self-confidence at home.
an10.215:1.13: Possessing these ten qualities, a female lay follower dwells without self-confidence at home.
an10.215:2.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing ten qualities, a female lay follower dwells self-confident at home.
an10.215:2.3: (1) She abstains from the destruction of life …
an10.215:2.13: Possessing these ten qualities, a female lay follower dwells self-confident at home.”
